pool.text: Seru Epenisa Cakobau granted land to the Australian-based Polynesia Company in Suva.
Control of the Fiji Islands was ceded to the United Kingdom.
Pratt was appointed Surveyor-General and designed the new capital in Suva.
Fiji's capital was moved to Suva from Levuka by the colonial authorities.
The administration of the colony was transferred from Levuka to Suva.
The original Government House on the site was built in Suva.
Government House in Suva was rebuilt.
The creek was drained and foundations were created by driving concrete pilings.
The foundation stone was laid for the building complex in Suva.
The building complex in Suva was completed.
Suva annexed the Muanikau and Samabula wards, expanding its territory.
The Fiji Museum moved to its present location in Thurston Gardens.
A new wing was completed at the building complex in Suva.
Fijian independence took place, making Government House the residence of governors-general.
The seat of the Parliament of Fiji was moved to a new complex.
Suva hosted the South Pacific Games for the third time.
A low-rise building was constructed in a joint venture by FNPF and Tappoo Group.
The military-backed interim Fijian government dismissed municipal government officials in Suva.
Construction work began on a mini-mall complex at Grantham Road in Suva.
The mini-mall complex at Grantham Road was scheduled to be completed.
